entries.summary: The factsheet states a 0.85% management fee; the fee table and PPM state 1.25%.

counterpart.quote: Annual management fee: 1.25% of net asset value

entries.summary: The deck promises no exit charges; the fee table charges 2.00% on redemptions within 24 months.

counterpart.quote: Redemption charge: 2.00% on units redeemed within 24 months of purchase

entries.summary: The factsheet says investment-grade only; the PPM allows up to 40% sub-investment-grade.

citation.quote: The Fund invests only in investment-grade bonds.

counterpart.quote: 3.3 The Fund may invest up to 40% of its net assets in sub-investment-grade bonds.

entries.summary: The deck claims a fossil fuel exclusion screen; the PPM investment policy describes no such screen.

citation.quote: Every holding is screened to exclude fossil fuel companies.

entries.summary: The deck promises monthly income with no risk warning; the PPM says distributions are not guaranteed and may come from capital.

citation.quote: Target income of 6% a year, paid every month.

counterpart.quote: 5.2 Distributions are not guaranteed and may be paid out of capital.

entries.summary: The factsheet offers daily dealing; the PPM processes redemptions monthly with 30 days of notice.

citation.quote: Dealing: daily, on any business day

counterpart.quote: 7.3 Redemptions are processed monthly, on the last business day of each month.
